title: Name SyberLabs, a general partnership, as the operator in the Terms and Privacy Policy
acceptance: TERMS.md and PRIVACY.md name the operator as "SyberLabs, a general partnership" wherever they named an individual doing business as SyberLabs; the surrounding sentences, the California location and the contact address syberlabs.support@gmail.com are unchanged.
public/PRIVACY.md, public/privacy.html and public/terms.html are regenerated from the sources and match them (npm run verify:legal).
No other user-facing page, string or document names an individual as RISE's operator, publisher or contact.

evidence.note: Sections 1 and 18 of TERMS.md and sections 1 and 15 of PRIVACY.md now name SyberLabs, a general partnership; published copies regenerated with npm run build:legal.

On branch claude/legal-entity-syberlabs: npm run verify:legal, ci-hygiene (9 checks), roadmap:check (130 tasks), test:roadmap (23 pass), security:audit and security:compat, docs:diagram (ARCHITECTURE.md unchanged), content:build, fast unit suite (157 files, 3762 passed, 4 skipped), vite build, measure:first-load, both wrangler dry runs, and the browser gate (72 passed, 3 skipped, including the standalone policy page test) all passed locally. dist/terms.html and dist/privacy.html name SyberLabs, a general partnership.

summary: Legal-text correction: SyberLabs is now a general partnership, so the Terms and Privacy Policy name it, not an individual, as the operator.
